tasks.name: 负面提示词合流
tasks.commands:
<<taskjs>>
(async () => {
    const mod = await import('/scripts/extensions/third-party/LittleWhiteBox/modules/draw/providers/comfyui/comfy-draw.js');
    const on = mod.toggleMergeNegativeIntoPositive();
    window.toastr?.success(
        on
            ? '✅ 负面提示词合流 ON —— negative 置空，全部以 (tag:-1) 并入 positive'
            : '⚪ 负面提示词合流 OFF —— negative 照常下发'
    );
})();
<</taskjs>>
